request.subject: CITY:GOBLIN:1

layers.text: Remove all ground: erase the grass plate and the soil slab under the camp, so the tents and the hut stand directly on a transparent background with nothing at all under them. Remove the three small red flags. Recolour the round hide tents to pale sand-buff, colour #d0b073, with lighter #e6cc95 tops, and the hut's door to hazard yellow, colour #fdd20f. Keep the shapes of the tents, the tin hut, the lookout pole, the outline and art style exactly the same.
